{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Sentinel value -1 in customer_age:", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Filter for customers who CONVERTED (converted == 1)
converted_customers = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude customers with missing age (age == -1)
valid_converted_customers = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Confirm the mean age calculation
mean_age_converted = valid_converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Check distribution of customer_segment among converted customers
print("Customer segment distribution among converted:")
print(valid_converted_customers['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if customer_segment is balanced across converted group
# This is critical because channel was not randomized, and segment is correlated with channel
# We must ensure that our sample is not biased by segment

# Cross-tabulate converted vs segment
print("Cross-tabulation of converted vs customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(sales_df['converted'], sales_df['customer_segment']))

# Output mean age
mean_age_converted"}
